soundness_flags.label: ass:local-uniform-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: A uniform two-sided density-ratio bound over every nearby Hellinger law is a strong chart restriction, not the standard dominated/DQM semiparametric-model condition attributed to van der Vaart; retag it novel and delimit the finite-positive or otherwise verifiable regime.

soundness_flags.label: ass:transported-operator-continuity through ass:cokernel-gap-continuity
soundness_flags.one_line: On the stated uniformly separated fixed-rank closed-range chart, operator-norm continuity together with the positive reduced-modulus and fixed defect dimensions should yield kernel and cokernel projection continuity; prove that perturbation lemma or remove the separately assumed gap-continuity conditions.

soundness_flags.label: def:affine-ensemble-estimator and thm:affine-ensemble-inference
soundness_flags.one_line: The estimator is not fully defined: the fold-specific projection coefficient is written as one \(\widehat b_n\), and no explicit map from each pure/four-corner dictionary coefficient to the claimed affine weights and held-out signal is supplied.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:score-lifting-completeness; thm:quotient-efficiency through thm:affine-ensemble-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: General tangent equality and all general efficiency/inference claims remain conditional on the proposed reverse score-lifting result; the finite positive chart is the unconditional component.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Global quotient efficiency and affine-ensemble efficiency conditional on \(\mathcal T_P=\mathcal C_P^\perp\), with unconditional claims restricted to the explicit finite chart.

Theorem 3.1 gives the proximal EIF and local efficiency bound at the submodel with surjective operators and uniquely defined bridges.
